g.text: How well does ServeScope transfer to an unseen GPU?
Leave-one-GPU-out validation · target GPU excluded from fitting and inner function/scale selection
N = 599,147 | Mean absolute error 20.20% | Median 11.66% | P95 64.65% | Within ±20%: 68.1%
Every eligible observation is plotted. Relative error = (prediction − profile) / profile. GPU timing only; serving throughput and energy require separate validation.
